glossary.definition: (1) "Coroner" means the coroner or medical examiner of the county in which death occurs or the dead human body is found.
glossary.scope: (B) As used in the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires :

glossary.definition: (2) "Deputy coroner" means the deputy coroner or deputy medical examiner of the county in which death occurs or the dead human body is found.
glossary.scope: (B) As used in the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires :
